title: Realtime collaborative rooms
description: Actual local WebSocket rooms, presence, shared votes, reconnect, dedupe and optional Supabase presence.
limitations: Local rooms require a persistent process and are lost on restart.
Supabase presence votes disappear on disconnect and need private-channel RLS.

env.name: REALTIME_PORT
env.description: REALTIME_PORT is configured explicitly; see README for adapter-specific prerequisites and scope.

steps: Read the module README and choose local or explicit live adapter.

Register application routes and authorization explicitly; run module checks.
